title: A predictable refund arrives
hook: Two stated cases: explore a buffer after a stated spending path.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a buffer after a stated spending path affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Remaining, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a buffer after a stated spending path in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
